Stock market news | Zee Entertainment launches ₹600 crore buyback at ₹91 per share

Zee Entertainment announced a share buyback of up to 65.93 million shares at ₹91 per share. The tender offer opens on 1 December 2026 and runs for five days, closing on 7 December 2026.

The buyback totals about ₹600 crore and settlement of bids is scheduled by 14 December 2026. Promoters have chosen not to participate, indicating the offer is solely for public shareholders.
